parameters.query:
INSERT INTO measurement (time, sensor_id, sequence_number, value, battery_type, confidence_score, raw_condition)
VALUES (
  NOW(),
  (SELECT sensor_id FROM sensor WHERE name = $1),
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6
);

INSERT INTO alarm (sensor_id, time, level, value, threshold)
SELECT
  s.sensor_id,
  NOW(),
  CASE
    WHEN st.alarm_limit IS NOT NULL AND $2 >= st.alarm_limit THEN 'alarm'
    ELSE 'warning'
  END,
  $2,
  CASE
    WHEN st.alarm_limit IS NOT NULL AND $2 >= st.alarm_limit THEN st.alarm_limit
    ELSE st.warning_limit
  END
FROM sensor s
JOIN sensor_type st ON s.type_id = st.type_id
WHERE s.name = $1
  AND (
    (st.alarm_limit IS NOT NULL AND $2 >= st.alarm_limit)
    OR
    (st.warning_limit IS NOT NULL AND $2 >= st.warning_limit)
  );
